time_layout: Time axis first, cell axis second, field axis last. Native arrays float64 unless scalar metadata.

state_y.chart: log contents; not canonical in first two entries

grad_H_x.meaning: Derivative of scalar extensive H with respect to canonical state_x; no extra cell-volume division

rhs_dissipative_unit_y.meaning: Per-unit-kappa dissipative derivative. Add kappa times this to conservative_y.

heat_cells_unit.meaning: Per-cell extensive heat power per unit kappa, already spatially measured. Sum over cells for total power.

unit_mobility.meaning: Exact native unit-kappa constitutive coefficient; available as a supervision label, not an input to the frozen model

H.meaning: Mechanical Hamiltonian evaluated on each native state

heat_ledgers.total: Sum entries 0,1,2,3 only; entry 4 overlaps earlier components

reference_volume.meaning: Exact Euclidean spherical reference shell measure

time.units: Native model units, not calibrated seconds

pytorch_layout: OperatorDataset returns state/rate/gradient tensors as (8,128); WindowDataset returns (frames,8,128). Batching adds the leading batch axis.

prediction_npz.optional: time must exactly equal case.time if supplied

scope: All 50 shipped cases are fixed-grid synthetic references in one manufactured initial-state family. No physical experimental labels or spatial continuum targets are claimed.
